patch_list: Overrides Du Chinese's local subscription and next-lesson checks for research. Server entitlement and content availability remain unverified.
Experimental native Google-service routing through app.revanced.android.gms. Requires MicroG; sign-in and notification delivery need device verification.

Adds the Volley error class, HTTP status, cause locations, lesson and request URL presence, and safe response metadata to Du Chinese's reading download dialog. Does not change requests or account entitlement.
